create_Assignment: create an Assignment NamedTuple with variable names and bounds for MIP variable assignments
run_sample_probas: run sample_probas to obtain variable probabilities from a TensorFlow SavedModel on a GraphsTuple
build_RandomSampler: build a RandomSampler that randomly unassigns a given number of binary variables from a MIP
build_RepeatedCompetitionSampler: build a RepeatedCompetitionSampler that selects top-K variables to unassign using model-predicted probabilities
test_SAMPLER_DICT: test SAMPLER_DICT to retrieve RandomSampler or RepeatedCompetitionSampler by string key
